

#remove cardiomyocyte genes

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(viridis)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(sctransform)
library(ggplot2)
library(harmony)
library(ggsci)
library(ggpubr)

```

#working directory
```{r}
setwd("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/7 hlhs sc dex/2 cardiomyocyte censoring/adipocyte/")
```


#pseudobulkdex tables
```{r}
donor_hlhs <- read.csv("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/7 hlhs sc dex/donor_hlhs/adipocyte_Donoradipocyte_HLHS.csv")

syshf_nf <- read.csv("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/7 hlhs sc dex/nf_syshf/adipocyte_NFadipocyte_SysHF.csv")

donor_nf <- read.csv("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/7 hlhs sc dex/donor_nf/adipocyte_Donoradipocyte_NF.csv")

donor_syshf <- read.csv("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/7 hlhs sc dex/donor_syshf/adipocyte_Donoradipocyte_SysHF.csv")
```


#vector of cardiomyocyte marker genes
```{r}
globalmarker <- read.csv("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/6 hlhs clean global object/hlhs_clean_globaltype.csv")

cm <- globalmarker[globalmarker$cluster == 'cardiomyocyte',]
cm <- cm[cm$avg_log2FC > 1.0,]
cm <- as.vector(cm$gene)

cmdf <- as.data.frame(cm)
```

#donor hlhs intersection
```{r}
clean_donor_hlhs <- donor_hlhs[!donor_hlhs$X %in% cm,]

donor_hlhs
clean_donor_hlhs
```

#syshf nf intersection
```{r}
clean_syshf_nf <- syshf_nf[!syshf_nf$X %in% cm,]

syshf_nf
clean_syshf_nf
```

#nf donor intersection
```{r}
clean_nf_donor <- donor_nf[!donor_nf$X %in% cm,]

donor_nf
clean_nf_donor
```

#syshf donor intersection
```{r}
clean_syshf_donor <- donor_syshf[!donor_syshf$X %in% cm,]

donor_syshf
clean_syshf_donor
```

#save tsv
```{r}
write.table(clean_donor_hlhs, file="donor_hlhs_intersection_censored.tsv", sep="\t", quote=F, col.names=NA)

write.table(clean_syshf_nf, file="syshf_nf_intersection_censored.tsv", sep="\t", quote=F, col.names=NA)

write.table(clean_nf_donor, file="nf_donor_intersection_censored.tsv", sep="\t", quote=F, col.names=NA)

write.table(clean_syshf_donor, file="syshf_donor_intersection_censored.tsv", sep="\t", quote=F, col.names=NA)
```
